name: Selection Box
description: A phrase gets a box drawn round it, and a pointer arrives at its corner as if someone just selected it.

props.name: children
props.description: The phrase to highlight. It stays on one block, so keep it short.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the box outline, its faint fill and the pointer.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait after the phrase scrolls into view before the box starts to draw.

props.name: rectangleClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the box, for example a different radius or border.

props.name: pointerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the pointer's wrapper.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the inline wrapper. Also accepts every other prop of a span.
